title: Book of business
caption: Premium in force, active policies, concentration and upcoming renewals for a producer, by account and state.
story: A producer wants to know what they depend on. The tiles show premium in force, active policies, the share held by the largest account and renewals coming in 90 days.
The account bars show concentration at a glance. The register below puts each account's renewal date, renewal status and unpaid premium in one row, so the next call is obvious.

title: Active policy tooltip
caption: The tooltip page for active policies and premium renewing.
story: A tooltip page. It shows active policies, employer accounts and premium renewing in 90 days, with a note that premium in force is annualised and counts active policies only.
